summary: Master IT Governance and IT Service Management with our expert-led training course. Gain essential skills to elevate your professional journey in IT.
lede: IT governance training connects technology oversight with consistent IT service delivery. It is for professionals who oversee technology decisions, IT operations, risk, or service performance and need to link oversight with day-to-day work. Learners practice clarifying decision rights, assessing risks, shaping incident and change workflows, and using service measures to build dashboards and improvement roadmaps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who govern, operate, assure, or report on IT services and technology decisions. It suits intermediate to advanced practitioners who already work with IT operations, technology risk, service performance, or digital delivery and need a joined-up governance and ITSM operating model.
modules: IT Governance Maturity and Risk Assessment
prerequisites: You need practical exposure to IT operations, IT service delivery, technology governance, audit, risk, or digital transformation. The course uses structured datasets and templates, so you do not need access to a live ITSM platform. Bring a laptop if you want to adapt the dashboards, registers, and roadmap templates during the exercises. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted ticket classification, automated change workflows, CMDB data quality, and governance analytics receive operational application treatment.
